objective: Expand the upstream industry-engine surface with one unchanged generic absolute-opportunity prior across four additional economically coherent families. No family-specific rescue, scarcity learner, allocator, threshold search, or external holdout consumption is allowed in this development screen.
primary_subset: positive-value states outside each test symbol's frozen prior-history top30 momentum rule
chronology: same fold geometry, purge, +1 session execution, fixed20 horizon and 25 bps stock cost as #137/#142
symbol_gate: at least 20 primary states; positive stock net after 25 bps; positive stock-after25-minus-sector-ETF gross return; positive stock net in at least 3/5 folds; positive stock-after25-minus-sector-ETF in at least 3/5 folds
family_gate: at least 5/8 development symbols pass the symbol gate
holdout_rule: external holdout histories remain unloaded unless that family independently passes its 5/8 development gate
